caption:
Surah Al-Asr: three verses about time and what saves us from loss.

Faith, good deeds, and reminding each other of truth and patience. Listen, then read it again slowly.

Surah Al-Asr 103:1-3

Send this to a friend who reminds you of what matters.

#quranreels #surahasr #timeisprecious #quranreminder

Recitation: Mohamed Siddiq Al-Minshawi
alt_text: By the time; man is in utter loss; except those who believe and do righteous deeds, and exhort one another to the truth and exhort one another to patience (Surah Al-Asr 103:1-3)
